title: Earned Wage Access Bundle Terms for Card Kits — Paystride Payroll Card Program
content:
**Bundle term.** Holding a live Paystride Earned Wage Access Program Agreement changes the kit fees of the Paystride Payroll Card Program: while the employer's Earned Wage Access Program Agreement has status live on a kit order's date, the first kits ordered in that calendar month, up to the package's bundle kits per month and counting the kits already supplied without kit fee in that month under the bundle, carry no kit fee; shipping is still charged.

**Launch order.** The bundle and the kits supplied without fee with the launch order do not add up on the same order: the launch order uses whichever supplies more kits without fee.

**Card destination promise.** Where the package offers workers paid on the card fee-free early wage transfers to it — every package does — workers paid on the card are told they can receive early pay on it without a transfer fee; that promise is kept under the Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan, not by a credit on the payroll card program.

### Kits without kit fee left in a month

| Earned Wage Access Program Agreement live on the order date | Kits without kit fee available to the order |
|---|---|
| yes | the package's bundle kits per month less the kits already supplied without kit fee that month under the bundle |
| no | none under the bundle |

### Hypothetical cases (Select package, 50 bundle kits per month)

- With a live agreement and 20 kits already supplied without fee this month, an order of 125 kits carries no kit fee on 30 kits and the Select kit fee on the other 95, plus shipping.
- A launch order under the Advantage package with a live agreement: the launch supplies 100 kits without fee and the bundle 50, so the launch order uses the 100.
